author: HarryRules2002
body:
So, today I thought of a game where for the 1st hour, anyone who wants to enter can put down there IGN in the comments. I will give everyone exactly 1 hour, after that hour is gone, I will get a randomiser and put all the letters in. I will then choose a letter, if this letter is in your IGN you are eliminated, this will keep on going until eventually there is a winner or everyone is eliminated. I hope you guys enjoy this game that I made up! (By the way, there is no prize as of yet)

EDIT: Sorry if you have only numbers, I will do another one soon with numbers (You can compete in both if you have both numbers and letters)
